entries.en: to steady or support with the hand
to press down with the hand; to hold down
to prop (something) up so that it does not fall

entries.zh: 使忧苦、折磨（人）；憔悴愁苦
entries.en: to afflict, to distress; to be worn and sorrowful
entries.notes: 单字「憔」取「憔悴、忧苦」义以合 L 栏 affligir，系本组词族首字。

entries.en: to grieve; to be heartsick
to be in extreme agony; to be tormented
entries.notes: H 栏「凌剔」当为「凌迟」之借写（R 栏 lêng chŷ 可证），取受极刑般折磨义。

entries.en: affliction; suffering, tribulation
bitterness; hardship, suffering
to suffer bitterly; to be in great pain
to be miserable and grieved by hardships
to weep bitterly in grief
to wail and cry out in grief
to grieve and weep and be worn out
entries.notes: L 栏 agastarse 为古语「耗竭、憔悴」义，据 H、M 栏「惨切」定为悲伤至身心耗竭。

entries.en: to shrink from hardship; to avoid trouble
entries.notes: L 栏 refusar 当读如 rehusar「畏避」，与 H 栏「避难」相合。

entries.zh: 把人气到极点、活活气死
entries.en: to exasperate someone to the point of death
entries.notes: L 栏「hasta que melle la sangre」（至见血）与 H 栏「气杀人」义域略异，取气极伤人之义。

entries.en: to make someone die of rage; to exasperate to death
so afflicted that only death remains; at death's door from grief
entries.notes: H 栏「局々死」构词罕见，据 L 栏「只差一死」及 M 栏重叠音定为愁苦濒死。

entries.en: to loosen; to let go, to release
to loosen what is tied; to untie
entries.notes: H 栏「放伊拎」末字疑为借字，据 L 栏「afloxar lo atado」定为解开捆缚。

entries.zh: 放松所缚之物；减免刑罚
entries.en: to loosen (what is bound); to relax; to remit a punishment
